description: Everything Impreza stores about this account: every field, what it is for, how long it survives, and who else necessarily sees it — plus, for the fields with a retention window, whether the oldest surviving row actually agrees with the window we advertise. Answers "what did I leave here" and "is the retention policy real" without taking either on trust. Returns counts and date ranges, never the contents. Use it before trusting this platform with something sensitive, to audit us, or to find out which of your data you can still make us forget.
name: impreza_privacy_report
